title: Customer-Pay Repairs Discount Program Terms
content:
## Terms

1. One discount program at most applies to a Customer-Pay Repairs repair order; discounts never stack.
2. A fleet account takes the fleet discount (the tier's fleet percentage). An individual may qualify for the military program (the tier's military percentage, for active-duty military and veterans), the senior program (the tier's senior percentage, for customers aged 65 or older) or the returning-customer program (the tier's returning-customer percentage), and when more than one is met the program giving the largest discount amount applies.
3. A customer is a returning customer when the customer has at least one delivered repair in the look-back window, counting delivered Insurance Claim Repairs or Customer-Pay Repairs repair orders within the tier's look-back in calendar months before the opening date. The window is that number of calendar months ending on the opening date of the repair order being discounted.
4. The discount is the program percentage of the discount basis amount (the quoted total, or the quoted labor where the tier's discount base is labor only), capped at the tier's discount cap and rounded to the cent. The discount basis amount is the quoted total when the tier's discount base is total and the quoted labor when it is labor only; the program percentage is the percentage of the single program applied. The discount is therefore the lesser of the tier's discount cap and the basis amount multiplied by the program percentage, rounded to the cent.
5. The discount posts as one discount credit against the quoted work charge on the start date.
6. Additional work, restocking, storage and fees are never discounted.
7. The program is recorded on the repair order at opening and is not changed afterwards.

## Who takes which program

| Customer | Programs considered | Program applied |
|---|---|---|
| Fleet account | fleet | the fleet discount |
| Individual meeting none of the three | - | none |
| Individual meeting exactly one | military, senior or returning customer | that one |
| Individual meeting two or three | military, senior, returning customer | the one giving the largest discount amount |

## Worked examples (hypothetical orders; percentages and caps from the Customer-Pay Repairs discount program rate table)

**A. Several programs met (Panel Repair Service: military 10 percent, senior 5 percent, returning customer 5 percent, labor only, cap 250.00).** An individual who is a veteran, aged 67, with a delivered repair 10 months before the opening date; quoted labor 1800.00, quoted total 3000.00. The basis is the 1800.00 of quoted labor. Military gives 180.00; senior gives 90.00; returning customer gives 90.00. The military program applies: one discount credit of 180.00, below the 250.00 cap, against the quoted work charge on the start date.

**B. The cap (Customer-Pay Collision Service fleet account: 8 percent, labor only, cap 500.00).** Quoted labor 7000.00: 8 percent is 560.00, capped at 500.00.

**C. Rounding (Cosmetic Touch-Up Service senior customer: 5 percent of the quoted total, cap 75.00).** Quoted total 333.33: 5 percent is 16.6665, rounded to the cent 16.67.

## Returning-customer window (hypothetical dates, 24-month look-back)

| Opening date | Earlier repair | Delivered date | Counts |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-06-10 | Insurance Claim Repairs repair order | 2025-01-20 | Yes, delivered within the window |
| 2026-06-10 | Customer-Pay Repairs repair order | 2023-11-05 | No, delivered before the window |
| 2026-06-10 | Customer-Pay Repairs repair order cancelled before delivery | none | No, never delivered |

## Points of judgement

- The program is fixed at opening, so a later change in the customer's circumstances does not change the program on that order.
- An additional work charge, a restocking fee, storage and fees never carry a discount credit.
